FIGURE: willowy and long-limbed with soft curves — a full bust, rounded hips and a slender waist — keep this exact build from the attached image, neither slimmer nor fuller.

BODY: a normal human body — one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; elbows, knees and wrists bend the human way. Hands and feet may be partly hidden by the pose, what she holds or the frame. Right and left mean her own right and left, not the viewer's.

free_design.Place: An open-air river ferry crossing with a plain wooden passenger bench and late-morning light
free_design.Activity: She catches the echo of the ferryman's bell and slips a wrapped sweet into her coat pocket for the friend she is meeting across the river
free_design.Pose: Seated three-quarter front, right hand holding the wrapped sweet just above her coat pocket, left hand resting palm down on the bench beside her
free_design.Framing: Vertical 2:3 medium portrait with the ferry rail and rippled river behind her
free_design.Outfit: An opaque raspberry silk halter with folded petal panels and a bare back, a matching short wrap skirt secured with a matte brass side clasp, and an open ecru shoulder cape
